title: Radio Télé Métropole Journalist Wesly Renaud Jean Kidnapped in Delmas 31
detail: Journalist Wesly Renaud Jean of Radio Télé Métropole was kidnapped by heavily armed men on the afternoon of Sunday, September 6, 2026, in the Delmas 31 neighborhood of Port-au-Prince, according to witnesses. His abduction came a day before two more prominent Haitians — attorney Caleb Jean-Baptiste and ONAPE Director General Stéphanie Paultre — were seized in a separate incident in the Artibonite department. Haitian authorities had not publicly confirmed the circumstances of Jean's abduction or his whereabouts as of September 9. Press freedom monitors noted Jean was at least the sixth journalist kidnapped in Haiti so far in 2026, underscoring the widening reach of gang violence into professional and media circles in the capital.

media.caption: Journalist Wesly Renaud Jean, among three prominent Haitians kidnapped within 24 hours in early September 2026
